youtube.caption:
Napoleon dumped his fiancée for Josephine. Big mistake 👑

What would YOU text an ex after a glow-up like this? 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Napoleon was engaged to Désirée Clary in 1795, then dropped her and married Josephine in 1796. In 1798 Désirée married Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte, one of Napoleon's generals. Sweden made Bernadotte its crown prince in 1810; in 1813 he led an allied army against Napoleon, and in 1818 he became King of Sweden, with Désirée as his queen.
